Name: Adventurer's Guild Shop Overhaul (1.6 compatible)
Author: TaisceRayne
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds [/size][size=3]the following to the bottom of Marlon's sale menu:
[/size]
[u]Monster Loot:[/u][list]
[*]Slime (loot) - 5
[*]Bat Wing - 15
[*]Bug Meat - 8
[*]Solar Essence - 40
[*]Void Essence - 50
[*]Bone Fragment - 12
[/list][u]
Slime Eggs:[/u][list]
[*]Green Slime Egg - 1000
[*]Blue Slime Egg - 1750
[*]Red Slime Egg - 2500
[*]Purple Slime Egg - 5000
[*]Tiger Slime Egg - 8000
[/list]
[u]Monster Machines:[/u][list]
[*]Slime Incubator - 2050
[*]Slime Egg Press - 975
[*]Wicked Statue - 1125 (cost to build plus cost of recipe)
[/list]
[list]
[/list]All prices are easily configurable using GMCM, and all items are buyable
starting in year 1!

[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
No known issues with any other mods. If you have a mod that completely
overrides the Adventurer's Guild shop list then I could see those conflicting.

[size=4][b]To Install:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! Just drag this bad boy into your mods folder and you should be good to
go! If you want to change the prices, you can edit the config.json or
use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to edit it right in your game!

[size=4][b]To Uninstall:[/b][/size]
Delete it! Shouldn't cause any issues in current playthroughs, it only touches the Adventurer's Guild shop.

[size=4][b]Recommended Mods[/b][/size]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20648]Friendships Affect Prices[/url] for obvious reasons
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27102]Clint Shop Overhaul[/url] for machines that felt they fit Clint's shop more
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27249]Willy Sells Fish Machines[/url] for machines that felt they fit Willy's shop more
